tess (People Ops): Quick reminder: review cycle closes Friday 11:59pm PT. Managers should sign-off by Thu 5pm PT. If you need extra time, submit the extension form.

ben (Eng Manager): One manager can't attach files in the form. Alternate upload path?

tess (People Ops): Use a single Drive/Notion link in the examples field or email reviews@redwood.com with manager cc. We'll attach for you.

olivia (IC): Are contractors excluded automatically if started mid-cycle?

tess (People Ops): Contractors with start <=30 days before close => Not Eligible. 31-90 days => Manager summary allowed. Mark Worker Type accordingly.

sam (Hiring Ops): FYI we added CSV bulk upload for managers (docs link in Console). Use it if you have >8 directs to submit.

notify-bot: :bell: Reminder sent to folks who haven't submitted yet.

ben (Eng Manager): Where's the export for my team's reviews?

tess (People Ops): Console > Reviews > Team > Actions > Export CSV. For individual summaries: My Reviews > Export Summary. If you hit permission errors, ping me.

tess (People Ops): Office hours today 16:00-17:30 PT at https://cal.redwood.com/reviews-help. DM if blocked and we'll triage. Good luck!
